subject: Shift in priorities — pause on inference pilot and next steps
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novainteract.com>, Priya Nair <p.nair@novainteract.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + demo availability (Redwood Inference)

Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the quick call earlier. Per our conversation, we'd love to run a 30–45 minute demo focused on:
- how Redwood reduces per-token cost via prefix caching and batching
- routing/rollback strategies for hybrid hosted/dedicated setups
- an integration checklist for teams migrating from a monolithic API

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 19 May, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 20 May, 14:00–14:45

Attached: proposed-agenda.pdf, pre-demo-checklist.md (short list for your infra/security folks). If those times don't work, tell me preferred windows and I will rebook.

If helpful I can include a short cost/throughput sketch tailored to the architecture you described — ping me the key concurrency targets and sequence lengths.

Thanks,
Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0191

Attachments:
- proposed-agenda.pdf (PDF, 0.2MB)
- pre-demo-checklist.md (text, 3KB)

Date: 2027-05-14T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo availability (Redwood Inference)

Dev —

Really appreciate the detail and the flexible slots. Heads-up on two changes on our side that affect timing:
1) Our VP of Product has reallocated a chunk of Q2 focus to the analytics platform backlog; the inference/LLM pilot has been deprioritized for the immediate sprint.
2) Key engineers (including the potential primary implementer) will be traveling for our global offsite May 17–21, which means we won't have the right people on the demo.

Given both, we should pause the live demo for now and revisit early Q4 when priorities are clearer.

That said, we'd find an asynchronous walkthrough useful (short recorded demo + the pre-demo checklist you sent). If you can send a 15–20 minute recorded walkthrough and an abbreviated cost one-pager, we can circulate internally while roadmap planning happens.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Platform Integrations | NovaInteract
alex.chen@novainteract.com
